style: Use this exact character: small glowing mint-green gummy blob, black pixel-LED sunglasses with green dot lenses, small smile, little green flag. Stylized 3D character in a real photographic world, cinematic, 16:9 widescreen. Fill the whole frame with the scene.
negative: deformed character, extra limbs, fingers, text, watermark, blurry

chorus1-1.keyframe: Cinematic macro photo: a smartphone lying in tall grass at sunrise golden hour; the character is halfway out of the glowing screen, one stubby arm on the phone's edge, climbing out into a jungle of giant grass blades. Warm backlight, dew, shallow depth of field.
chorus1-1.motion: The small glowing mint-green gummy character in black pixel sunglasses pulls itself up out of the rippling liquid phone screen in three bouncy heaves, one on each beat, pops free and lands in the grass, then raises its little green flag. The camera swoops low through the giant dewy grass blades and rises up into a wide sunrise park. Warm backlight, lens flare, playful energetic motion.
chorus1-1.reactive: punch-in on each 'down', bloom pulse on downbeats (hardest section)

intro-1.keyframe: Dark bedroom at 2 AM: a man in his thirties (short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie) lies in bed in profile, face lit cold blue by a phone propped on the pillow beside him, the scrolling feed reflected in his glasses, tired eyes. On the phone's glowing screen, tiny, the character stands inside the glass tapping on it from the inside. Deep shadows, blue light, cinematic, no hands in frame.
intro-1.motion: Almost still. The blue light flickers as the feed scrolls; his eyes track the screen. Inside the phone the tiny glowing character taps the glass twice. Very slow push-in toward the phone.
intro-1.foley: two soft glass taps from inside the screen

intro-2.keyframe: Close-up of a phone screen glowing in a dark bedroom, an endless social feed of blurred posts streaming past; the tiny glowing character stands inside the screen in front of the feed, looking out at the viewer, waving its little green flag.
intro-2.motion: The camera pushes forward into the phone screen in three surges, one on each 'down', until the glowing feed fills the frame and the camera passes through the glass into the stream of posts; the little character beckons it in.
intro-2.foley: a deep whoom on each push, the last one opening into a glassy rush

intro-3.keyframe: Abstract: falling through a tunnel of streaking blue and white light, blurred feed posts and notification bubbles stretched into long light streaks, the tiny glowing mint-green character tumbling among them, its green flag fluttering.
intro-3.motion: A fast continuous fall through streaks of light that accelerate and stretch; the character tumbles past the camera; at the very end everything flares to white, ready to match-cut into the verse.
intro-3.foley: the glassy rush continues from intro-2

verse1-1.keyframe: Inside the phone world: an endless vertical canyon built from social feed posts, cold blue and glitchy, notifications drifting like snow; the tiny glowing character points its green flag at the viewer.
verse1-1.motion: Continuing from the bounce: the character struts along the posts toward the camera, pointing its flag at the viewer on 'you'. Posts scroll endlessly up the canyon walls. Glitchy blue flicker.
verse1-1.foley: notification pings scattered through the feed

verse1-2.keyframe: A city skyline made of giant glowing podcast audio waveforms at night inside the phone world, doom headlines on billboards; a column of tiny identical figures in dark suits marches in lockstep along a waveform ridge, and the tiny glowing character walks the other way against them.
verse1-2.motion: The tiny suited figures march in lockstep along the waveform ridge while the waveforms spike red on doom words; the character walks against the flow, weaving between them. Slow tracking shot, claustrophobic blue.
verse1-2.foley: muffled podcast chatter, tiny marching stomps

verse1-3.keyframe: A cold blue feed landscape; the tiny glowing character holds a little green flag, a warm burst of color blooming where it planted another; a small glowing planet Earth floats beside it.
verse1-3.motion: On each 'Green flag' the character plants a flag and a warm burst of color blooms out of the blue; on the second a dog photo post pops into full color; on 'I don't want the planet' it hands the tiny glowing Earth back out of frame with a shrug.
verse1-3.foley: a soft pop on each green-flag bloom, a little 'boop' as the Earth is handed back

verse1-4.keyframe: The tiny glowing character lounging on a soft fluffy cloud made of glowing green code glyphs floating in the dark blue phone world; at the edge of the frame a giant phone charger plug dangles on its cable.
verse1-4.motion: The character flops happily onto the cloud of soft green code, its glow lighting the dark corners; on 'Go put your phone on the charger' it sits up as the giant charger plug swings into view.
verse1-4.foley: a soft cloud flump, the cable creaking as the plug swings in

verse1-5.keyframe: Inside the phone world: the tiny glowing character hauling a giant phone charger plug across the frame toward a glowing charging port, straining, cable trailing behind it.
verse1-5.motion: On the word 'charger' the character jams the giant plug into the port; a bright green charge bolt surges out and floods the whole frame.
verse1-5.foley: heavy plug CLICK on 'charger' (29.36), electric surge into a charging chime

prechorus1-3.keyframe: Sunlit kitchen in the morning: the character peeks out from behind a white coffee mug on the counter, much smaller than the mug; behind it a toaster is smoking, the toast burnt black. Warm golden window light, shallow depth of field.
prechorus1-3.motion: The small glowing mint-green character peeks out from behind the coffee mug, ducks back, then peeks out again with a little wave of its green flag, bouncing on the beat. Smoke curls up from the burnt toast. Slow gentle push-in, warm morning light.

prechorus1-1.keyframe: Bedroom at dawn: a man in his thirties (short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie) bolting upright in bed, startled awake as if from a bad dream, soft morning light through the curtains, his phone on the nightstand lit up and buzzing with an incoming call. No hands in frame.
prechorus1-1.motion: He jolts awake and sits up sharply as the phone buzzes on the nightstand, blinking at the morning light, catching his breath; he turns toward the ringing phone. Hard cut in, handheld feel.
prechorus1-1.foley: sharp breath in; phone buzz/ringtone; birds outside
prechorus1-1.note: The charge snapped him awake; Mom's call gets him up. Leaves the phone world.
prechorus1-1.overlay: 'Mom' as the caller name on the phone screen (composited, timed to 'your momma still calls')

prechorus1-2.keyframe: Warm sunlit kitchen in the morning: a phone lying on the wooden counter next to a coffee mug, its screen stacked with group-chat message bubbles; the character lounges on top of the phone like a sun-warmed cat. Real, cozy, golden window light.
prechorus1-2.motion: Group-chat bubbles keep popping up on the phone screen in quick succession; the character lounging on the phone bobs its head to the beat and lazily waves its flag at each new bubble. Gentle slide along the counter.

intro-4.keyframe: (chained: first frame = last frame of intro-3)
intro-4.motion: The fall through the light streaks accelerates even more, the streaks bending into a tunnel; the tiny character spins past the camera; everything flares to pure white on the final beat before the drop.
intro-4.foley: a rising whoosh that ENDS on the drop at 11.53 (the next bar); the echoed 'hey hey hey' is already in the song
intro-4.match_cut_to: intro-5 (land in the phone world out of the white flare)

intro-5.keyframe: Inside the phone world: an endless vertical canyon built from social feed posts, cold blue and glitchy; the tiny glowing character stands on a post mid-bounce, flag raised.
intro-5.motion: Out of the white flare the canyon resolves; the character bounces once on each of the four 'down's, higher each time, then spins to face the camera on 'hey, hey, hey' and points its flag at the viewer.
intro-5.foley: a springy boing on each bounce

chorus1-2.keyframe: Macro photo at sunrise: a jungle of giant dewy grass blades, warm low backlight and bokeh; the tiny glowing mint-green character mid-leap between the blades, flag streaming behind it.
chorus1-2.motion: The character bounds through the giant grass blades toward camera; on 'come back around' the camera spirals up and out of the grass, revealing a wide sunrise park with long shadows.
chorus1-2.foley: grass swishes on each bound, a soft whoosh on the spiral up

chorus1-3.keyframe: A sunrise park lawn: a giant silver paperclip looms over the tiny glowing character, and the sky behind is streaked with menacing red laser beams.
chorus1-3.motion: On 'no paperclips' the character flicks the giant paperclip away like a bug and it tumbles off; on 'no laser skies' the red laser streaks fizzle out and the sky melts into a plain blue morning sky crossed by a few ordinary jet contrails; on 'green flag' the character plants its flag on a little grassy hill.
chorus1-3.foley: a tinny ping as the paperclip is flicked, a laser powering down, a distant jet; a soft pop as the flag is planted
chorus1-3.note: paperclip = the paperclip-maximizer AI-doom meme; laser sky -> contrails = a wink at today's conspiracy chatter

chorus1-4.keyframe: Wide sunrise park: a huge slowly swirling spiral of grey notification bubbles hangs in the sky above the trees; the tiny glowing character stands on the grass looking up at it, flag in hand.
chorus1-4.motion: On 'low, low, low' the spiral unwinds a turn at a time, dropping lower; on 'let the spiral go' it dissolves into a flock of birds that scatter across the morning sky. The character waves them off.
chorus1-4.foley: notification hum fading down, then a burst of wings and birdsong
chorus1-4.reactive: three soft dips on 'low, low, low'

verse2-1.keyframe: At night on a bedside nightstand, at the tiny character's scale: a miniature lab set-up next to an alarm clock and a charging phone, the sleeping man (short dark messy hair, grey hoodie) a soft blur in bed beyond. The glowing mint-green character stands on a small wooden lazy Susan under a tiny spotlight, mid-spin, black pixel sunglasses on.
verse2-1.motion: The lazy Susan spins the character slowly under the spotlight; on 'screenshot' a camera flash pops white for an instant.
verse2-1.foley: lazy Susan creak, camera shutter + flash pop on 'screenshot'
verse2-1.note: additive scene: each shot adds pressure; verse2-2..7 chain from the previous shot's last frame

verse2-2.motion: Still spinning on the lazy Susan, the character now curls a pair of tiny dumbbells, one arm then the other, straining comically.

verse2-3.motion: Still spinning and curling, colorful rubber balls fly in from all sides and bounce harmlessly off the character, which stays calmly in place.

verse2-4.motion: Peak pile-up: little green flags pop up all over the nightstand, waving, while the balls keep bouncing and the lazy Susan keeps spinning.
verse2-4.overlay: tally counter spinning up to 90 (composited, timed to 'ninety times')

verse2-5.motion: The character pushes its sunglasses up onto its head, then swats a big red button under a glass dome off the edge, then swats a little golden crown away after it.
verse2-5.foley: two cartoon swats, glass dome clatter, a tiny crown tinkle

verse2-6.motion: On 'down' the black pixel sunglasses drop from the top of its head down onto its face, deal-with-it style; it strikes a cool pose.
verse2-6.foley: a pixel 'bling' as the shades land on 'down' (76.92)

verse2-7.motion: The character hops off the lazy Susan and runs across the nightstand past the scattered debris (rubber balls, tiny dumbbells, the crown) toward the edge by the bed.
verse2-7.foley: tiny pattering steps, a ball rolling away

verse2-8.keyframe: At night by the bed: the tiny glowing character at the edge of the mattress tugging the blanket up over the sleeping man's shoulder (short dark messy hair, grey hoodie), the nightstand with a charging phone beside them.
verse2-8.motion: The character tucks the blanket over the sleeping man, then hops onto the charging phone on the nightstand and settles there like a nightlight, glowing softly; its lenses blink once, then switch off, and the room goes dark on the last beat.
verse2-8.foley: soft blanket rustle, a contented little sigh, the faint click of the lenses switching off; silence
verse2-8.note: The AI as a nightlight, not an overlord. Dark -> next morning: prechorus2 opens on the kettle clicking.

prechorus2-1.keyframe: Morning kitchen: an electric kettle on the counter in a puff of steam; through the window behind it a porch light is still on in the soft dawn; a phone on the counter shows a long group-chat argument; the tiny glowing character perches on top of the kettle.
prechorus2-1.motion: The kettle clicks off and steam billows up; message bubbles keep stacking on the phone; the character on the kettle watches the pointless argument and rolls its eyes with its pixel lenses, then shrugs.
prechorus2-1.foley: kettle CLICK on the cut (82.77), steam hiss, message pops
prechorus2-1.note: the kettle line starts at 81.78 over the dark nightlight frame; the cut to morning lands as 'clicks' ends

prechorus2-2.keyframe: (callback: reuse the prechorus1-3 keyframe, same framing, slightly softer morning light)
prechorus2-2.motion: The character peeks out from behind the coffee mug, ducks back, then peeks out again with a little wave of its green flag; smoke curls up from the burnt toast. Slow gentle push-in.
prechorus2-2.note: the line repeats, so the picture rhymes

chorus2-1.keyframe: A sunny backyard playground: the tiny glowing mint-green character at the top of a small bumpy wavy slide, flag raised, bright blue morning sky.
chorus2-1.motion: The character whooshes down the bumpy slide, bouncing on three bumps, one on each 'down', and lands in the grass on 'touch grass', rolling once.
chorus2-1.foley: three plastic thumps on the bumps, a happy landing boing

chorus2-2.keyframe: Sunny backyard lawn: a small red-gold and white parti-colored Lhasa Apso with a long silky shaggy coat, fringe falling over its eyes, dark-tipped ears and a plumed tail curled over its back bounding toward the camera with a giant silver paperclip in its mouth, the tiny glowing character in the grass, blue sky with a couple of kites.
chorus2-2.motion: On 'no, no, no paperclips' the dog bounds in proudly carrying the giant paperclip, shakes it and drops it at the character's feet; on 'no laser skies' the camera tilts up to kites dancing in a clear blue sky.
chorus2-2.foley: dog tags, a metallic clatter as the paperclip drops, kite flutter
chorus2-2.note: callback: the paperclip Blip flicked away in chorus1-3 comes back as the dog's toy

chorus2-3.keyframe: a small red-gold and white parti-colored Lhasa Apso with a long silky shaggy coat, fringe falling over its eyes, dark-tipped ears and a plumed tail curled over its back trotting across a sunny lawn with the tiny glowing character riding on top of its head, holding its little green flag up high.
chorus2-3.motion: The character rides on the trotting dog's head, flag up on 'green flag'; on 'low, low, low' it slides down into a little garden hammock that sinks lower with each 'low'.
chorus2-3.foley: dog tags jingling, hammock creaks on each 'low'
chorus2-3.reactive: three soft dips on 'low, low, low'

chorus2-4.keyframe: Macro, sunny lawn: a dandelion seed head in sharp focus, the tiny glowing character beside it, soft bokeh of the garden behind.
chorus2-4.motion: On the spoken 'Breathe out' a soft breeze blows the dandelion apart in slow motion, seeds drifting across the frame and catching the light; the character watches them float away.
chorus2-4.foley: a soft exhale of wind, near silence: a gentle landing into the bridge

bridge-1.keyframe: Dusk: the tiny glowing character sits small on top of a dark, switched-off phone lying on a wooden surface as if sitting on a porch step; its black pixel sunglasses are pushed up on its head, three dark dot eyes and a small smile visible, lenses dark; faint reflections of comment threads scroll on the glass behind it. Quiet, intimate, warm dim light.
bridge-1.motion: Very still. The character sits and listens, swinging its little feet; faint comment threads drift across the dark glass in reflection. Almost no camera movement.
bridge-1.foley: vinyl crackle only (the beat is out)
bridge-1.look: bridge look: shades up, dot eyes, smile (assets: char_bridge_candidate / sheet lenses_off)

bridge-2.keyframe: Dusk, close: the tiny glowing character holds a phone charger plug out toward the camera with both stubby arms, offering it, sunglasses pushed up, soft smile.
bridge-2.motion: The character slowly holds the charger plug out toward the camera, offering it, then nods gently. Very slow push-in.
bridge-2.foley: vinyl crackle; a tiny cable rustle

bridge-3.keyframe: Dusk: the tiny glowing character standing up on top of the dark phone, sunglasses on its head, looking up with determination.
bridge-3.motion: The character stands up as the riser builds; its sunglasses drop back down onto its face; at the very end a red gingham picnic blanket swoops in front of the camera and completely fills the frame.
bridge-3.foley: the riser + snare roll is in the song; a big fabric whoosh at the end
bridge-3.transition_out: hidden cut: last frames are all red gingham fabric; chorus3-1 opens on the same fabric (blend a few frames)

chorus3-1.keyframe: Frame completely filled by a red gingham picnic blanket billowing toward the camera, a hint of golden-hour park light glowing through its edges.
chorus3-1.motion: The billowing blanket floats away from the camera and settles onto the grass, revealing a golden-hour park; then phones drop onto the blanket from above, out of frame, one on each 'down', and a fourth on 'way down'.
chorus3-1.foley: blanket flap, then a soft thud per phone landing

chorus3-2.keyframe: Wide golden-hour park picnic: the red gingham blanket on the grass with a pile of phones face-down on it; a small red-gold and white parti-colored Lhasa Apso with a long silky shaggy coat, fringe falling over its eyes, dark-tipped ears and a plumed tail curled over its back racing around joyfully; the tiny glowing character riding on the dog's back, flag streaming.
chorus3-2.motion: The dog tears around the picnic in a big happy loop with the character riding on its back, flag streaming; warm low sun, long shadows, lens flare.
chorus3-2.foley: dog tags jingling, happy barks, distant park sounds

chorus3-3.keyframe: Golden hour, close: a man in his thirties (short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses) wearing a flannel shirt in warm brown, amber and cream plaid, eyes closed, face turned up to the warm sun, smiling, the tiny glowing character sitting on the shoulder of his flannel shirt. No hands in frame.
chorus3-3.motion: He breathes in the sun, smiling, eyes closed; the character on his shoulder waves its flag on 'still alive'. Gentle, warm, slow push-in.
chorus3-3.foley: warm breeze, birdsong under the music
chorus3-3.note: his daylight reveal: same you, still alive

chorus3-4.keyframe: Golden hour, close on the man's flannel sleeve in warm brown, amber and cream plaid; the tiny glowing character at the top of the sleeve near the shoulder, about to slide.
chorus3-4.motion: The character slides down the flannel sleeve in three dips, one on each 'low'; the camera pushes in until the plaid fills the frame; on 'let the spiral go' the plaid warms and its straight lines resolve into wooden porch floorboards and a railing at dusk, the sleeve cuff becoming the porch railing with the character sitting on it.
chorus3-4.foley: three fabric zips on the slides, a warm whoosh into the porch
chorus3-4.transition_out: texture morph: chained motion + a short dissolve into outro-1; keep the character's glow at the same screen position across the cut

outro-1.keyframe: Dusk: a wooden front porch, the tiny glowing character sitting on the porch railing (same screen position as the end of chorus3-4); the man in his flannel sits on the steps below with the dog; warm porch light.
outro-1.motion: The porch light flicks on; the man leans back on the steps, the dog settles beside him; the character swings its feet on the railing.
outro-1.foley: porch light switch click, crickets beginning

outro-2.keyframe: Dusk, close: a phone lying on a wooden porch step showing a message thread, the tiny glowing character sitting beside it.
outro-2.motion: A new message slides into the thread on the phone; the character looks at it, then up at the man, content.

outro-3.motion: The phone's screen locks and goes black; the porch light glows warm in the darkness behind it.
outro-3.foley: phone lock CLICK (cue c03, lands before 'Delivered')

outro-4.keyframe: Night: darkness, a warm porch light glowing, fireflies beginning to rise over the lawn.
outro-4.motion: Fireflies rise slowly through the dark around the glowing porch light.

outro-5.keyframe: Night lawn full of drifting fireflies, one larger soft mint-green glow among them: the tiny character floating up.
outro-5.motion: The fireflies drift upward; the character's mint-green glow floats up among them like one of them.

outro-6.motion: The glows drift higher and dimmer as everything slowly fades to black.

theme: The camera gets pulled into the doomscroller's world inside the phone; Blip is there to add color and reset him back to real life.

blip.look: small glowing mint-green gummy blob, black pixel-LED sunglasses with green dot lenses, small smile, little green flag

scroller.look: a man in his thirties, short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie, tired eyes
scroller.todo: design 3-4 options, the director picks, then a sheet like Blip's
scroller.look_day: same man, daytime: flannel shirt in warm brown, amber and cream plaid (porch colors: the plaid resolves into porch boards in the chorus3 -> outro morph)

dog.look: a small red-gold and white parti-colored Lhasa Apso with a long silky shaggy coat, fringe falling over its eyes, dark-tipped ears and a plumed tail curled over its back
dog.note: the man's dog (verse 1: 'I like your dog'); reference photo
